title: Why Being Helpful Leaves You Overwhelmed
description:
Every quick yes takes time from somewhere. This illustrated story follows a helpful person whose small favors begin to crowd out his own plans—and the practical changes that help him give a more honest answer.

We explore the pressure to agree, the hidden tradeoffs behind a favor, and ways to clarify what you can actually offer. The aim is sustainable generosity, not rejecting everyone or treating friends as enemies.

Modern Life Inc. — Understand people. Understand modern life.
Subscribe for illustrated stories about relationships, work, money psychology and everyday decisions.

This is a fictional illustrative story with AI-assisted artwork and synthetic narration. Examples are general educational suggestions, not a diagnosis or a guarantee of how other people will respond.

Research and further reading:
Flynn & Lake (2008), “If You Need Help, Just Ask”: https://doi.org/10.1037/0022-3514.95.1.128
Mogilner, Chance & Norton (2012), “Giving Time Gives You Time”: https://doi.org/10.1177/0956797612442551

#Boundaries #PeoplePleasing #ModernLife
